newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ports of Auckland in NZ$25.8 mln disposals.
newsitem.headline: Ports of Auckland in NZ$25.8 mln disposals.

text.p: Ports of Auckland Ltd said on Wednesday it had sold a 98-year leasehold interest in Princes Wharf, and the Ports of Auckland building, to the Kitchener Group of companies for NZ$25.75 million.
The sale by international tender included the leasehold interest in the wharf, covering existing wharf buildings, along with access around its perimeter.
Ports of Auckland will maintain ownership of the wharf deck and all support structures.
POA said the agreement preserved Ports of Auckland's ongoing use of certain wharf areas and water space to facilitate the berthing of vessels, particularly passenger vessels.
Settlement of the purchase is on February 11, 1998.
POA said the sale paved the way for the redevelopment of Princes Wharf and was the result of Ports of Auckland's review of its asset base and continuing focus on its core port operational activities.

David Henderson, Managing Director of Kitchener, said his company intended to redevelop the wharf to include a five star hotel at its northern end, serviced apartments and various mixed commercial activities.
The development will also include facilities for an overseas passenger terminal.
